facts.value: Entry changes to CaptureLeadead and installs item-notifying damage/death callbacks, source-item storage and a computed grab timer. Anim subtracts a configured step, applies common mash input and on resulting <=0 detaches/notifies the item before CaptureCut initialization. IASA and Phys are empty. Coll's helper currently invokes the adapter on zero/GA_Ground, not GA_Air. CaptureCut initializes a selected horizontal velocity field and capture_timer; item destruction is an alternate caller. The final adapter forwards CaptureLikelike death notification through its damage-notification path. Pointer lifetime, finite tuning values and valid state scheduling are external preconditions.
